mapper.update: UPDATE dcws_nonstandard_approve set status=#{status},user_Id=#{userId},update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select * from (SELECT RES.task_Id,RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_Id FROM dcws_nonstandard_approve RES INNER JOIN dcws_nonstandard_approve_user AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select * from (SELECT distinct RES.task_Id,RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_Id FROM dcws_nonstandard_approve RES INNER JOIN dcws_nonstandard_approve_his AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id where AHP.update_time is not null ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
